يصطحبوا (form VIII)
# يَصْطَحِبُوا (yaṣṭaḥibū) /jasˤ.tˤa.ħi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# يُصْطَحَبُوا (yuṣṭaḥabū) /jusˤ.tˤa.ħa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
